editorial:
Imagine being a kid who loves pulling pranks and making comic books. That's George and Harold, two best friends who spend their days dreaming up wild adventures and causing trouble at school. When their strict principal threatens to split them up, they accidentally hypnotize him into becoming Captain Underpants, a goofy superhero who wears nothing but underwear and a cape. The movie is packed with silly humor, bright colors, and a fast pace that keeps you laughing from start to finish. It feels like a Saturday morning cartoon brought to life, with heart and energy that kids and parents can both enjoy.

The animation is fun and creative, mixing in different styles like flip-book sequences and sock puppet scenes that keep things fresh. The voice cast brings great energy, especially Kevin Hart and Thomas Middleditch as the two leads. The humor is silly and sometimes gross, which kids will love but some adults might find a bit much. If you enjoy lighthearted family comedies, this one is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, the evil scientist Professor Poopypants tries to erase laughter from the world using a giant robot. George and Harold team up with Captain Underpants to stop him. The principal snaps out of his trance just in time, but he decides to keep pretending to be the hero because he enjoys it. The boys realize their friendship is what truly matters, and they get to stay in the same class. It's a happy, silly ending that wraps everything up nicely.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly family comedies and animated adventures.
